rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Superior Electoral Court's diploma, dated Brasília 10 December 2018 and signed by Minister Rosa Weber as President, states that Jair Messias Bolsonaro was elected President of the Federative Republic of Brazil by the vote of 28 October 2018 and qualifies him for investiture before the National Congress on 1 January 2019.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The signed termo de posse printed in the full issue records that at 15:00 on 1 January 2019, before the National Congress in joint session in the plenary of the Chamber of Deputies, Jair Messias Bolsonaro and Antônio Hamilton Martins Mourão were solemnly empossados under article 78 of the Constitution as President and Vice-President, elected on 28 October 2018 and diplomados by the TSE on 10 December 2018, for the period 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2022, and recited the commitment.

locator.section: Termo de posse with the signatures

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Superior Electoral Court's diploma reproduced in the issue states that, by the will of the people expressed at the ballot of 28 October 2018, Antonio Hamilton Martins Mourão, candidate of the Coligação Brasil Acima de Tudo, Deus Acima de Todos (PSL/PRTB), was elected Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil, and that the diploma qualifies him for investiture before Congress on 1 January 2019; it is dated Brasília, 10 December 2018, and signed by Minister Rosa Weber as President.

locator.section: diploma image (item 2.1 of the summary: 'Diplomas do Exmo. Sr. Jair Messias Bolsonaro e do Exmo. Sr. Antonio Hamilton Martins Mourão')

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The signed Termo de Compromisso records the oath under art. 78 of the Constitution given on 1 January 2019 by Antônio Hamilton Martins Mourão, 'eleito para o cargo de Vice-Presidente da República em 28 de outubro de 2018 e diplomado em 10 de dezembro de 2018'.

locator.section: Termo de compromisso with signature (item 2.2 of the summary)

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The signed Termo de Posse records that at 15:00 on 1 January 2019, before Congress in joint session in the Chamber's plenary, Jair Messias Bolsonaro and Antônio Hamilton Martins Mourão were solemnly empossados under art. 78 of the Constitution as President and Vice-President, respectively, elected on 28 October 2018 and diplomados by the TSE on 10 December 2018, for the period 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2022.

locator.section: Termo de posse with the signatures (item 2.3 of the summary)
